Commentary.Commentary: So that ends our coverage of the second T20I between West Indies and Pakistan. The Men in Green clawed their way back and won their 6th T20I in a row. They have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead in this 4-match series. The hosts once again crumbled under pressure. However, they still have 2 matches left and can still level this series. The next game takes place on 1st April at 1230 local time (1630 GMT) at the same venue. Until then, take care! Cheers!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the almighty. Feels that the way they started was not good but Shadab bowled really well. Adds that the boys played well. Mentions that Shadab Khan is a brilliant bowler and he should continue his efforts. Ends by thanking the coaching staff as they have been very supportive.

Man of the Match, Shadab Khan thanks the almighty for the win and his performance. Feels that it was a similar wicket to Barbados but was a touch slower and had more turn in it. Picking Samuels' wicket was a crucial one and was very happy after taking it.

West Indies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite thinks that his team started well with the ball but then let it slip. Adds that they have a team plan but it's upto individuals to execute it. And mentions that there's still a lot to improve. Reckons that after seeing the result one thinks that one should have done things the other way round. The plan was right but the execution wasn't.

Marlon Samuels was batting well and looked in good flow. He played some classic shots and stitched a 50-run stand with Walton, keeping the Windies in the hunt. But it was Shadab Khan who foxed him and that swung the momentum in favour of the tourists. There was a 33-run stand from 32 balls for the 7th wicket between Holder and Brathwaite with the former being the aggressor. The skipper was perhaps slow to get going and it put his side under pressure. Finally, Hasan Ali bowled an intelligent final over and defended 13 runs to lead his side to victory.

What a nail-biter the match turned out to be! Kudos to Pakistan for holding their nerves and coming out on top in this cliff-hanger. They now lead the 4-match T20I series 2-0 and cannot lose it from here. The visitors kept on taking regular wickets and didn't let the hosts off the hook. It was a modest score that they had posted on the board but the way their bowlers defended it deserves appreciation. Shadab Khan was once again sensational and weaved his magic around. He ended with figures of 4-1-14-4 and triggered a collapse.

PAKISTAN WIN BY 3 RUNS! Well done, Hasan Ali. The young man has kept his nerves and led his side to a sensational victory. Very full outside off, Holder can only jam it beside the pitch on the off side and take a single. Hasan Ali is pumped up and so are his teammates. A brilliant game of cricket this has been!
SAMUEL BADREE walks out in the middle. But it's Jason Holder facing the last ball. 5 runs are needed off it. Can the ODI skipper win it for the Windies?

OUT! NARINE GETS RUN OUT! And Pakistan inch closer! Short of a length ball on middle, Narine looks to pull it but drags it back towards Ali. Holder wants strike and takes off but Narine reacts late. Ali has ample time to go back to the bowler's end and whips the bails off calmly.
Intelligent bowling by Ali. He bowls a slower delivery and it's on a length and it's cutting across, Narine swings across the line but misses. 5 runs needed from 2 balls.

Pressure on both the teams! After conceding boundaries off the first two deliveries, he bowls a dot ball but then bowls a wide delivery. The pendulum is swinging to and fro. Meanwhile, both the batsmen gather in the middle to have a chat while Sarfraz also gives Hasan a piece of advice. 5 runs are needed off 3 deliveries.
Wide! Ali sprays it down the leg side this time, Narine looks to pick it up over square leg but misses. It is a matter of nerves now. Who can hold it in the end and emerge victorious?
Ali answers him with a good comeback! Bowls a slower length delivery on off, Narine looks to slog it across the line but gets beaten.

FOUR! Narine punishes him for a loosener! Low full toss on off, Narine lofts it over Hasan Ali's head and the ball races to the fence. The Windies crowd is dancing in the aisles. West Indies need 6 runs from 4 balls. Game on!

FOUR! The change of bat seems to be working for Narine! That's a lovely shot! Take that, Ali! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Narine clears his front leg and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
HASAN ALI to bowl the last over. West Indies need 14 from 6 balls. Can they pull it off? Meanwhile, Sunil Narine changes his bat.
A precious dot to end the over. Fullish delivery well outside off, Holder throws his bat at it but fails to make contact.
FOUR! Bowls this on a length this time and the line is wrong. It's around the hips, Holder swipes it through square leg and the ball races to the fence. The hosts need 14 runs from 7 balls.
Fullish delivery outside off, Narine drives it hard towards extra cover and the batsmen set off for a run. The throw is at the striker's end but misses.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Narine can only manage to push it down the track.
SUNIL NARINE strides out to bat.

OUT! Timber!  Riaz steams in and bowls a fullish delivery on middle and leg at 148 clicks, Brathwaite clears his front leg and looks to slog it over mid-wicket. But his head position is nowhere and he ends up missing it to gets his stumps rattled. Riaz is ecstatic and so are his teammates. The umpires check for the no ball but he is fine. West Indies need 19 from 10 balls.
Brathwaite is cleaned up and is told to wait by the umpires as they want to check for the no ball.
A play and a miss! Very full outside off, Brathwaite looks to drive it square of the wicket but misses.
This is sensible batting! Dabs a back of a length ball towards backward point and runs one. 20 runs required from 12 balls.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Holder stays back and turns it through square leg for a single.
In the air... but safe! On a length in line of the stumps, Brathwaite makes room and drags his slog over mid on and the ball lands in front of Malik near the fence. Single taken.
On a length on middle, Jason makes room and swats it down to long on for a single.

SIX! Going, going, gone! Fuller length ball outside off at 108 clicks, Holder clears his front leg and smacks it downtown. Has got the elevation and the power behind it and the ball clears the fence with ease.
Terrific yorker on middle, Brathwaite is equal to the task and jams it through mid on for a single.
Good change of pace! Slower and on a length outside off, Holder is foxed by the change of pace. West Indies need 30 from 18 balls
Low full toss outside off, Carlos hits it through covers for a single.
Full length ball on off, drilled through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Full length delivery on off, Holder shuffles a touch and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length on off, Carlos backs away and swats it down to long off for a single.
Very full delivery on middle, Holder drills it to long on for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ comes back into the attack.
Well bowled! Dot balls are very precious at the moment. Slower delivery around off, Carlos looks to turn it across but is foxed by the lack of pace. The hosts need 38 runs from 24 balls.
Short of a length ball slanting across Holder. He taps it towards backward point and completes a quick run.
Slower and fullish ball on off, Brathwaite chips it over mid-wicket for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length on off, Carlos turns it nicely towards square leg for a run.
Length delivery on off, punched to long off for a single.
SOHAIL TANVIR comes back for a bowl.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Slower delivery around off, Brathwaite crouches and scoops it in between the keeper and short fine leg for a boundary. West Indies need 43 from 30 balls.
Good length ball on middle again, Brathwaite looks to swipe it across but misses and the ball whizzes over the stumps.
That missed the stumps by a whisker! On a length on middle, Brathwaite looks to play it across but misses and the ball goes just over the stumps.
Short of a length outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length on middle and leg, turned through backward square leg for a couple.
HASAN ALI is back on.
Tossed up around off, driven through covers for a single. The batsmen look for the second but the fielder cuts it off well.
This time Brathwaite plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A touch short outside off, Braithwaite stays back and defends it.
A touch short outside off, played to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
IMAD WASIM is back on.
JASON HOLDER walks out to bat.

OUT! THIS CAN BE THE GAME CHANGER! It's a maiden-wicket for Shadab Khan, what an over! Bowls the wrong one outside off and it's quicker in pace, Samuels stays rooted to his crease and looks to block it but gets a faint nick. Sarfraz behind the stumps grabs it nicely. West Indies need 52 from 42 balls with 4 wickets in hand. Shadab ends with figures of 4-1-14-4.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to point.
Slower through the air outside off, Samuels dabs it towards the short third man fielder.
Tossed up outside off, played with an open face past first slip.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers.
A touch shorter, angling in, dabbed in the short mid on region. A quick single is taken.
Back of a length outside off, cut through behind point for a single.
The batsman defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
Short delivery wide outside off, slashed hard over backward point for a single.
On a length outside off, guided to third man for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on.
Served outside off, Samuels covers his stumps and leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, punched to long on for a single.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE walks out to bat. He will be facing the hat-trick ball. Meanwhile, Ahmed Shehzad has come back to the field. Good to see him fit and fine.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Flatter one around middle, spinning away, Powell doesn't pick it. He is late into his shot and the ball goes on to disturb the woodwork. Shadab is proving to be a thorn in the flesh of the hosts again. Can this be the turning point of the game?
ROVMAN POWELL is the new man in, replacing Pollard.

OUT! SHADAB OUTFOXES POLLARD! Loops it nicely outside off, lures Pollard out of the crease and he obliges. Fails to get to the pitch of the ball and the ball spins away from him. Sarfraz behind the stumps collects it and whips the bails off in a flash. Pollard fails again. West Indies need 55 runs more to win. Can the tide turn?
Fuller one on middle, defended neatly from within the crease.
Pollard gets to the pitch of the ball and clips it on the bounce over mid-wicket. It's in the gap and the batsmen run a couple.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Samuels checks his shot, gets it uppishly to covers.
FOUR! On a length outside off, Samules backs away and punches it on the up through wide of mid off for a boundary.
Length delivery, angling in, Samuels backs away and punches it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Samuels doesn't miss out! Low full toss outside off, Samuels drives it through the gap between mid off and covers for a boundary.
Angling into the batsman, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
KEIRON POLLARD is the new man in.

OUT! ALI STRIKES! Change works for Pakistan. Length delivery, angling in, nips back in a touch too. Simmons looks to defend it but is late onto his shot. He is rapped on the front pad and and there is a loud shout for lbw. The umpire rules it out immediately. West Indies need 68 runs from 65 balls to win.
HASAN ALI comes back into the attack.
Outside off, dabbed to point.
FOUR! Shortish delivery, sliding in, Samuels goes back and punches it through front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to covers.
Served outside off, spinning in, Samuels prods forward to defend but gets it off the outside edge towards slip.
Spinning into the batsman, milked to long on for a single.
LENDL SIMMONS is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Beautifully bowled by the young leggie. Fires in a googly around middle, Walton dances down the track but is completely beaten by the variation. The ball goes through and knocks the leg pole. That's the end of Walton's innings. Can there be a twist in the tale? West Indies still need 73 runs off 71 deliveries.
50-run stand up for Samuels and Walton.
SIX! Over the ropes! Slides this into the pads, Samuels once again skips down the track, clips it over mid-wicket. This one is all about timing. 19 runs off the over!
SIX! Smoked it! Fullish delivery outside off, Samuels dances down the track and tonks it over the bowler's head for a huge maximum. Samuels is on the charge.
Straightish mid on comes in place.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Samuels uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Powerful hit! Fuller delivery outside off, Samuels uses his feet a touch, hits it straight down the track. The umpire tries to get out of the way but fails to do it. He is his hit on the left leg. Even then, the ball races to the long off fence. Such is Samuels' power.
Sliding in, played with the angle to mid-wicket for a single.
IMAD WASIM is back on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Shout for lbw! Fuller one outside off, Walton kneels down and looks to paddle it but misses. Players appeal but it's turned down. Impact outside off maybe.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched to point for a single.
FOUR! Short delivery outside off, spinning in, Samuels goes back and cuts it through the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Served fuller around off, pushed to left of the bowler.
SHADAB KHAN is now brought into the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full outside off, driven to covers. A misfield by Wasim allows the batsmen to take a single.
Wide. Down the leg side, Walton looks to clip it but misses. Wide signalled.
A touch short delivery, angling away, Walton looks to pull it but gets an inside edge into the pads.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, pulled over mid-wicket. Hasan in the deep, runs to his left, parries the ball towards the substitute Nawaz. A brace taken.
On a length outside off, punched to covers.
Length delivery angling away, worked to deep square leg for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is into the attack now.

Length delivery, angling in, defended down the pitch. Walton skips down the track. Hasan sees that, picks the ball and hits the woodwork at the striker's end with his throw. Appeals for run out but it's turned down.
Back of a length delivery outside off, keeps a touch low, Walton fails to pick the bounce and the ball goes from under his bat. Sarfraz does well to stop it, diving to his left.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Again it's on a length outside off, Walton heaves it over mid-wicket. Gets one bounce and across the fence.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Length delivery outside off, Walton plays with the angle. Lofts it over widish mid on for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to mid-wicket.
Fuller length delivery around middle, angling in, flicked on the leg side for a single.
HASAN ALI comes into the attack.

The physio is out in the middle to treat Ahmed Shehzad. While running towards the ball, he collided with Walton. Walton happened to step on Shehzad's right hand and then his left knee hit the neck. He is in extreme pain. His teammates circle around and check on him. The ambulance arrives and out comes the stretcher. He is carried off. Doesn't look good but hope he gets fine.

Length delivery, angling across, Samuels defends it with soft hands beside the pitch. Shehzad from point sprints towards the ball but fails to pick it. As Walton tries to complete the run, he steps on Shehzad's right hand and then collides with him.
Length delivery, angling across, defended down the track with soft hands. Samuels looks for a single but is sent back.
Length delivery around leg, angling away, defended off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, dabbed behind square on the off side for a single.
Fuller on the boots, clipped to deep square leg for a single. There's another collision at the bowler's end between Tanvir and Walton but this time no harm down.
Shortish delivery, skidding in, punched to long on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sliding into the pads, clipped through widish mid on for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Lbw appeal, turned down! Sliding down leg, Walton looks to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads but it's turned down. Going down leg maybe.
Fullish delivery, driven towards Wahab Riaz at mid off who fumbles a touch and concedes a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
MARLON SAMUELS walks out to bat.

OUT! LEWIS IS REALLY UNLUCKY TO DEPART! Back of a length delivery on off, Lewis punches it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Imad Wasim hares in front, crouches low and hurls in an underarm throw at the bowler's end. Unfortunately, Shadab Khan runs from extra cover to back up and Lewis tries to avoid him. Evin Lewis gets blinded and loses his bat in the process. Wasim has hit the bull's eye and the umpire takes it upstairs. The southpaw seems to be struggling. The replays show that Lewis is short of his ground and he walks back disappointed.
A run out appeal against Lewis is taken upstairs.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Five Wides. Sprayed down the leg side, Lewis looks to clip it but misses. Sarfraz Ahmed is late to react and dives but fails to stop it. Five wides signaled by the umpire.

That was close! Short of a length ball outside off, Lewis looks to punch it through the off side but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. The batsmen are coming back for the second but Imad Wasim sprints from mid on and gets across to it in a flash and throws at the bowler's end. The mid off fielder comes to the stumps and tries to effect a run out but Lewis had made it in.
On a length in line of the stumps, Walton clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
SOHAIL TANVIR to bowl from the other end.
Shortish outside off, Lewis punches it off his back foot to covers.
Slider on middle and leg, Walton drags it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, driven to long on for a single and Lewis gets off the mark.
Shorter length ball on off, Lewis camps back and defends it.

We are back for the chase. EVIN LEWIS and CHADWICK WALTON to open the batting for West Indies. IMAD WASIM to start off with the ball. Can West Indies chase the total down? Or will they choke? First ball of the second innings coming up. Here we go...
